an4.259:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an4.259:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājāniyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca
an4.259:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.259:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an4.259:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.259:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an4.259:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an4.259:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an4.259:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an4.259:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an4.259:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an4.259:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti.
an4.259:7.1: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
